iteration: breadcrumb head variant for in-place navigation

clarity.notes: New §03 specifies the drill-in contract explicitly: back chevron + clickable parent crumbs + leaf title, window-local, never a new window. Anatomy legend A–D mirrors §02.

hierarchy.notes: Identity still renders once — at depth the back chevron replaces the glyph and the trail reads as a path. Toolbar, status and actions swap per level so chrome stays two bars max.

typography.notes: Crumbs 13px/500 quiet, leaf 13px/600, 150px crumb truncation, '/' separators; run log in 11px JetBrains Mono.

motion.notes: Push/pop is instant state swap in the mock (production gets the window-content transition); pulse dots and caret carry liveness. Reduce-motion honored.

brand.notes: Accent only in state dots, primary actions and the caret. Stop run at run level is deliberately neutral; the '…' collapse crumb stays faint.
